name: new-destination-bulk-exfiltration
condition: External destination unseen before, unusually large outbound transfer and high-severity corroborating exfiltration alert
basis: MITRE ATT&CK T1041/T1048: data may be exfiltrated via a command channel or alternative protocol.

name: off-hours-archive-exfiltration
condition: Archive upload to external address outside working hours, additionally large or unapproved, with high-severity exfiltration evidence
basis: MITRE ATT&CK T1048: archive transfer over an alternative network protocol is consistent with possible exfiltration.

name: outbound-transfer-review
condition: Partial evidence: first-seen external address, high volume, off-hours archive or a T1041/T1048 alert without a corroborated clear attack
basis: MITRE ATT&CK T1041/T1048: isolated network anomalies warrant investigation but are not proof requiring blocking.
